notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.intro: Choose wetin we go remind you about, and how.
notifications.mealsHint: Small reminder for your normal food time.
notifications.waterHint: Few small reminders for the day.
notifications.consultationsHint: E dey on always, so you no go miss any call wey you book.
notifications.channelError: Abeg leave at least one way wey we fit take reach you.
notifications.quietHint: No reminder between these times, except for doctor meetings.
notifications.serverNote: Daily check-in reminders and family alerts dey come as phone notifications (on am for up). Text message, WhatsApp and email reminders dey come soon; wetin you choose don save.
notifications.checkInHint: Reminder if you never do your daily check-in by this time.

privacy.title: Privacy and data
privacy.intro: Na you dey control your information. Under Nigeria data protection law, you fit see, correct and delete wetin we keep about you.
privacy.termsAgreed: Terms of use and Privacy policy
privacy.healthAgreed: To use your health information to make your plans fit you
privacy.healthHint: If you withdraw this one, we go stop to make your plans fit you. Contact us to withdraw.
privacy.downloadBody: File wey get everything Living Dose keep about you for this phone: health checks, meal plans, food diary, orders, appointments and more.
privacy.deleteLocal: Delete my data from this phone
privacy.deleteLocalBody: E go remove your health checks, meal plans, diary, habits, orders and other things wey save for this phone. Your account go still dey.
privacy.deleteTitle: You wan delete your data from this phone?
privacy.deleteBody: You no fit undo am. We advise make you download your data first.
privacy.deleted_one: We don delete {{count}} item from this phone.
privacy.deleted_other: We don delete {{count}} items from this phone.
privacy.accountBody: We go delete your account and all the data wey we keep for our servers, except wetin law say make we keep, like order records for tax. We go confirm by message.
privacy.accountButton: Ask make dem delete my account
privacy.deleteLocalBodySynced: E go remove your health check drafts, meal plans, diary, habits, saved articles and settings from this phone and from the copy wey sync for your account, so dem no go come back for your other phones. We go keep your health check results, orders and doctor meetings; ask us make we delete those ones.
privacy.syncNote: Your meal plan, diary, habits and settings dey sync for all the phones wey you sign in. Food pictures dey stay for the phone wey snap dem.

security.title: Sign-in and security
security.methodPhone: One-time code by text message to {{phone}}
security.noPassword: No password to remember or for person to steal. Each code dey work one time and e dey expire quick.
security.signOutAllBody: Sign out for every phone and computer wey you don use. E good if you lose phone.
security.signOutAllConfirm: You wan sign out of Living Dose for all your phones and computers?
tipsItems: Living Dose no go ever ask for your code by phone, message or email.
No share your code with anybody, even if person say e from Living Dose.
Put screen lock for your phone, because your health information dey inside.

display.title: Display and help
display.intro: Make Living Dose easy to use for this phone. These settings dey stay for this phone, so you fit set am up for your papa or mama.
display.simpleHint: Six big picture buttons, bigger writing, and button wey go read every page for you.
display.readHint: Press am make you hear how the phone voice be. For Simple view, the round speaker button dey read any page out.
display.readSample: Hello. Na Living Dose be this. I fit read every page for you.
display.familyHint: For Simple view, one big button go call this person.
